rules.prepare:
export PKG_CONFIG="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config"
# duplicate source tree for t in openssl gnutls nss do cp -a "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$t" done
# patch for non openssl builds patch -f -p1 -d "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/gnutls" -i "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/patches/"??_gnutls.patch patch -f -p1 -d "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/nss" -i "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/patches/"??_gnutls.patch patch -f -p1 -d "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/nss" -i "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/patches/"??_nss.patch
# rebuild configuration for t in openssl gnutls nss do cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$t" && autoreconf -fi # HACK: We cannot safely use LD_LIBRARY_PATH inside bbox. sed -i 's@export LD_LIBRARY_PATH@@g' configure done
# run configure in all source trees CONFIGURE_ARGS=" --prefix=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX --mandir=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/man --host=$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE --build=$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE --disable-symbol-hiding --disable-silent-rules --enable-versioned-symbols --enable-threaded-resolver --enable-ipv6 --with-lber-lib=lber --with-gssapi=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX --with-nss=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX --without-libidn2 "
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/openssl" ./configure $CONFIGURE_ARGS \ --with-ca-path=/etc/ssl/certs --without-nss --without-gnutls
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/gnutls" ./configure $CONFIGURE_ARGS \ --with-ca-bundle=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \ --without-ssl --without-nss --with-gnutls --without-libssh2
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/nss"
# HACK: to avoid colliding with glibc's nss.h sed -i 's@#include <nss.h>@#include <nss/nss.h>@g' lib/vtls/nss.c
LIBS="-lssl3 -lnspr4 -lplds4" CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -I$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/nspr -I$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/nss" \ ./configure $CONFIGURE_ARGS \ --with-ca-bundle=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \ --without-ssl --without-gnutls --with-nss --without-libssh2
rules.build: for t in openssl gnutls nss do make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" -C "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$t" done
rules.install:
for t in openssl gnutls nss do mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$t" make -C "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$t" DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$t" install
# compatibility symlinks if [ "$t" = "openssl" ]; then ln -s libcurl.so.4 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$t/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcurl.so.3" else ln -s "libcurl-$t.so.4" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$t/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcurl-$t.so.3" ln -s "libcurl-$t.so" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$t/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcurl.so" ln -s "libcurl-$t.a" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$t/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcurl.a" fi done
